attestations.text: LANG T'ing-chi 郎廷極 (T. 紫衡 and 紫垣, H. 北軒), May 16, 1663–1715, Feb. 25, official and scholar, was the descendant of a native of Liaotung. A son of Lang Yung-ch'ing 郎永清 (T. 定庵, 1620–1687), governor of Shantung in 1686–87, he came of a family which had had some military reputation in the Ming dynasty, but which later served the early Manchu emperors and belonged to the Chinese Bordered Yellow Banner.
